execution_gates.note: The registry contains quota slots only. No repository, issue, task, oracle, gold patch or holdout has been admitted.

source_policy.development_candidates: Public Rust-SWE-bench or issue-linked merged-PR tasks may be used as development candidates only after license, fix-visibility, source-revision, task-quality and oracle review.
source_policy.holdout_candidates: A holdout must not have a publicly visible task/fix pair or equivalent solution at the task freeze date. Public benchmark tasks cannot be called sealed merely because their files are kept outside the agent workspace.
source_policy.public_solution_search: Search source host, package registries, benchmark datasets, forks, commit history, release notes and available code indexes. Record search date, locations, query protocol and a digest of the search record. A search cannot prove absence of leakage.
source_policy.license_policy: Require a repository license expression and exact license-file digest. Unknown, missing or incompatible license provenance blocks admission.
source_policy.oracle_policy: Require two distinct human gold reviewers, blinded to the candidate model output. A third independent adjudicator resolves disagreement. LLM-only adjudication is prohibited.
source_policy.task_identity: Task identity binds repository full name, source commit, task specification digest, acceptance-contract digest and environment digest.

claim_boundary: This is an intake contract and quota plan, not a set of qualified or admitted tasks.
